MC.title: A familiar face
MC.brief: Isha has brought a fictional phone to the kiosk. Inspect the conversations, identify the pressure tactics, and rebuild what happened. No real money is used.
MC.closing: Case closed. You checked the evidence, named the tactics, and chose a safer response.
MC.debrief.mechanism: The sender creates a story, adds pressure, discourages outside checks, and asks for money or account access.
MC.debrief.c1: Pause before responding to a message that creates pressure.
MC.debrief.c2: Verify the claim through a contact you find independently.
MC.debrief.c3: Protect your payment details and ask a trusted person for help.
MC-E01: It is your cousin on this new number. My profile photo proves it.
MC-01.explain: A familiar photo and claimed relationship are not identity checks.
MC-E02: If you do not help, I will be stranded and it will be your fault.
MC-02.explain: Emotional pressure can be used to force a rushed decision.
MC-E03: Transfer right now. There is no time for a call.
MC-03.explain: Rejecting a call while demanding speed prevents verification.
MC-E04: Do not tell anyone in the family.
MC-04.explain: Secrecy blocks a second opinion from someone trusted.
MC-E05: Send Rs. 5,000 to this account belonging to my friend.
MC-05.explain: The impersonation leads to money being sent to an unfamiliar account.
MC-H1: The message uses a colourful banner.
MC-H1.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.
MC-H2: The message uses a smiley face.
MC-H2.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.

MC-CTX1.explain: This detail provides context but does not by itself prove a scam. Check the request and identity, not the colour or tone.

MC.fix.q: What is the safest next step?
MC.fix.safe: Stop the conversation, verify independently, and ask a trusted person for help.
MC.fix.safe.why: This removes the pressure and gives you a reliable way to check the request.
MC.fix.pay: Send the money first and check later.
MC.fix.pay.why: Sending money first gives the sender what they want before the claim is verified.
MC.fix.share: Share the requested account details to settle the matter.
MC.fix.share.why: Account secrets and device access should stay private, regardless of the story.
MC.replay.1: The sender starts a story to attract attention.
MC.replay.2: A claimed identity or frightening statement makes the story feel important.
MC.replay.3: A deadline creates pressure to act.
MC.replay.5: The sender asks for money, secrets, or control of the device.
MC-GOLD: The sender asks for an OTP as a second way to complete the transfer.
MC-G1.explain: An OTP can expose access to an account. Keep it private and verify the request independently.
